applicationDatabaseIsolation: one PostgreSQL instance; separate logical databases and users for metadata, counts and Keycloak; owner write/read-only grants
broker: one RabbitMQ node; persistent messages, publisher confirms, manual acknowledgements after side effects
hostPublishing: loopback only; infrastructure ports internal except identity/S3 browser endpoints; optional management ports must remain loopback
oidcFlow: authorization-code + PKCE S256; no browser secret
s3Addressing: path-style; separate internal control client and public presigning client; preserve signed host
secrets: generated/provisioned locally at setup; never part of source hashes or committed .env
topicSemantics: fanout exchange with a durable queue per subscriber; no historical replay, ordering between subscribers, or partitioned-log semantics
